cover: Hello, and a very warm welcome. Thank you so much for taking the time to be here. This is GoldenDose: a gentle medicine reminder for older people, with a companion app for their family. Together, we'll walk through both apps, one click at a time, nice and slowly, and I'll explain what each click does. Shall we begin?
legend: Before we start, a quick note on how to read this guide. There's one slide for every click. A red circle shows exactly where to click, and the rest of the screen is gently dimmed, so you always know where to look. The little red badge shows the step number, and what to do: click, type, read, check, or done.
sA: Now, whenever you're ready, let's move on to Part A: Getting started. That's clicks 1 to 10. In this part, we'll create a family account, sign out, and sign in. The family app opens at localhost 3000 slash care.
c01: Step 1. First, please click "Create an account". This opens the sign-up form, for a family member using GoldenDose for the first time. After that, the "Create your family account" form appears.
c02: Step 2. Next, kindly click "Your name" and type it. Your name appears in the app ("Hello, Meera") and in alert messages. After that, move on to the mobile number.
c03: Step 3. Now, if you would, please click "Mobile number" and type it. SMS and WhatsApp alerts about missed doses are sent to this number. After that, move on to the email.
c04: Step 4. When you're ready, please click "Email" and type it. Your email is how you sign in. Family members invite each other by email too. After that, move on to the password.
c05: Step 5. Now, please click "Password" and choose one. This protects the account. At least 8 characters. It's stored scrambled, never as you typed it. After that, click Create account.
c06: Step 6. Next, kindly click "Create account". This creates your account and signs you in on this phone. After that, "Hello, Meera" appears, with a box to add the first person you look after. Nicely done.
c07: Step 7. Now, if you would, please click "Sign out". This signs this phone out of the account. It's always at the top right. After that, back to Sign in. The rest of this guide continues as Priya, who already has people and medicines set up.
c08: Step 8. When you're ready, please click "Email" and type it. The email you signed up with. Demo account: priya@example.com. After that, move on to the password.
c09: Step 9. Now, please click "Password" and type it. This proves it's you. The dots hide what you type. Demo password: goldendose-demo. After that, click Sign in.
c10: Step 10. Next, kindly click "Sign in". This checks the email and password. If either is wrong, it says "Email or password is wrong." After that, "Hello, Priya" and the people she looks after: Kamala and Ramesh. That's all there is to it.
sB: Now, whenever you're ready, let's move on to Part B: Adding a medicine. That's clicks 11 to 22. In this part, we'll open a person, then add a medicine with its strength, instruction, time, shape and colour.
c11: Step 11. Now, if you would, please click a person: "Kamala". This opens that person's page. Everything about them is on one page. After that, kamala's page: today's doses, her medicines, her phone, and alerts.
c12: Step 12. When you're ready, please click "Add a medicine". This opens the form for a new medicine. It's below the list of current medicines. After that, the "Add a medicine for Kamala" form.
c13: Step 13. Now, please click "Medicine name" and type it. The only required box. Shown in large letters on Kamala's screen and alarm. After that, move on to the strength. Example: Calcium.
c14: Step 14. Next, kindly click "Strength" and type it. The dose, such as "500 mg". Shown next to the name and read aloud. After that, move on to the instruction.
c15: Step 15. Now, if you would, please click "Instruction" and type it. Read aloud to Kamala when the alarm rings. Mention the colour and when: "Take one orange tablet with water". After that, move on to the time.
c16: Step 16. When you're ready, please click the time and set it. When the alarm rings every day. Set the hours, minutes and AM or PM. After that, the time is set. Add more times for medicines taken more than once a day.
c17: Step 17. Now, please click "Add another time". This adds a second time, for medicines taken twice a day (or more, up to 12 times). After that, a new time row appears, ready to set.
c18: Step 18. Next, kindly click "Remove". This deletes a time you don't need. At least one time always stays. After that, that row disappears. Back to one time.
c19: Step 19. Now, if you would, please click "Take or choose a photo". This opens the camera or photo library. Photograph the strip or tablet: the photo replaces the drawing on Kamala's screen and alarm. After that, your photo shows in the square preview. It's uploaded when you save.
c20: Step 20. When you're ready, please click a shape: "Oval". This sets the shape of the pill drawing, used when there's no photo: Round, Oval or Capsule. After that, the chosen shape gets a green border, and the preview changes.
c21: Step 21. Now, please click a colour: "Orange". This sets the pill drawing's colour. Choose the real tablet's colour, so it matches what Kamala holds. After that, the preview turns into an orange oval tablet.
c22: Step 22. Next, kindly click "Add medicine". This saves the medicine. Kamala's phone picks it up within a minute. After that, back to Kamala's page, with Calcium in today's list and in Medicines. That's all there is to it.
sC: Now, whenever you're ready, let's move on to Part C: Connecting Kamala's phone. That's clicks 23 to 24. In this part, we'll get a one-time code in the family app, so Kamala never needs a password.
c23: Step 23. Now, if you would, please click "Get a connection code". This makes a 6-digit code to connect Kamala's phone, without a password. It's under "Kamala's phone" on her page. After that, a box appears with the code and the address to open on her phone.
c24: Step 24. Read the code and the address. The address to open on Kamala's phone, and the 6 digits to type. Works once, for 15 minutes. After that, pick up Kamala's phone and open that address.
sD: Now, whenever you're ready, let's move on to Part D: Using Kamala's app. That's clicks 25 to 33. In this part, we'll connect the phone, hear a medicine read aloud, answer the alarm, skip a dose, and undo a mistake.
c25: Step 25. Now, please click the code box and type the 6 digits. This links this phone to Kamala. The box is extra large so the digits are easy to see. After that, click Connect.
c26: Step 26. Next, kindly click "Connect". This connects the phone. It's remembered from now on. This tap also switches on the alarm sound. After that, "Good evening, Kamala" and today's medicines in time order. Easy, isn't it?
c27: Step 27. Now, if you would, please click "Read aloud". This speaks the medicine's name, strength and instruction, for when reading is hard. After that, the phone speaks. The screen stays the same.
c28: Step 28. When the alarm rings, click "Taken". This records the dose as taken, with the time, and stops the alarm. Take the pill first, then tap. After that, a green "Well done" screen.
c29: Step 29. Lovely! "Well done" confirms it. A big green tick and the time it was taken, for 2.5 seconds. After that, back to Today, or straight to the next alarm if another dose is due at the same time (here: Vitamin C).
c30: Step 30. Next, kindly click "Skip this dose". This records the dose as skipped, for when told not to take it today. The alarm stops. After that, back to Today. The card says "Skipped at…", and the family sees it in History.
c31: Step 31. Pressed by mistake? Click "Undo". This cancels "Taken" or "Skipped". Works for 5 minutes after the tap. After that, the card goes back to "Due now" with a Taken button. The alarm waits 5 minutes before ringing again.
c32: Step 32. When you're ready, please click "Taken" on the card. The same as the alarm's button, from the Today screen. A second tap within a second is ignored. After that, "Well done", then the card turns green.
c33: Step 33. Wonderful! The green card means "done". A tick and "Taken at 10:26 pm". Later, one glance answers "did I take it?" After that, back to the family app, to see what Priya sees.
sE: Now, whenever you're ready, let's move on to Part E: Checking and managing. That's clicks 34 to 50. In this part, we'll see what Kamala took, look back over the week, choose your alerts, invite family, stop a medicine, and sign out.
c34: Step 34. Next, kindly click "← All people". This goes back to the list of everyone you look after. Back links are always at the top left. After that, the people list: Kamala and Ramesh.
c35: Step 35. Now, if you would, please click "Kamala" again. This opens her page with up-to-date information, including what she just did on her phone. After that, kamala's page, with today's doses and their status.
c36: Step 36. Check today's status. Each dose with a label: green "Taken" with the time, grey "Skipped", red "Missed" (an alert was sent), yellow "Due now", or "Later". Here, Calcium shows "Taken 10:26 pm" and Vitamin C shows "Skipped", exactly as Kamala tapped.
c37: Step 37. Now, please click "Last 7 days". This shows every recorded dose for the past week, to spot patterns or answer the doctor. After that, History, newest day first, with "4 of 5 taken" for each day.
c38: Step 38. Next, kindly click "← Kamala". This returns to Kamala's page from history. After that, kamala's page.
c39: Step 39. Now, if you would, please click "How you're told about missed doses". This opens your alert choices and the invite form. It's at the bottom of the person's page. After that, the "Alerts and family" page.
c40: Step 40. When you're ready, please click a checkbox: "SMS". This turns SMS alerts on or off for you. Tick any mix of SMS, WhatsApp and app notification. Each family member chooses their own. After that, the tick disappears. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
c41: Step 41. Now, please click "Save". This saves your alert choices for this person. After that, a green "Saved" appears above the button. Easy, isn't it?
c42: Step 42. Next, kindly click "Their email" and type it. The email of a family member to invite. They need a GoldenDose account first (like Meera, from click 6). After that, choose what they can do.
c43: Step 43. Now, if you would, please click "What can they do?" This opens a list of two roles. Helper: see and change medicines. Main caregiver: also invite others. After that, pick one (Helper is already chosen), then click Invite.
c44: Step 44. When you're ready, please click "Invite". This links that person to Kamala, so they can see her medicines and get alerts too. After that, a green confirmation appears. Easy, isn't it?
c45: Step 45. Wonderful! The invitation worked. "Meera Iyer can now see Kamala's medicines." Kamala now has more than one caregiver. After that, next time Meera signs in, Kamala appears in her list.
c46: Step 46. Next, kindly click "← Kamala". This returns to Kamala's page, to manage her medicines. After that, kamala's page, with her medicines listed.
c47: Step 47. Now, if you would, please click a medicine: "Amlodipine". This opens it to change any detail (name, strength, instruction, times, photo, shape, colour), then Save changes. After that, the "Change Amlodipine" form, filled in with its current details.
c48: Step 48. When you're ready, please click "Stop Amlodipine". This starts stopping a medicine the doctor has stopped. It's at the bottom of the form, and it asks first. After that, a question: "Stop Amlodipine?" with "Yes, stop it" and "Keep it".
c49: Step 49. Now, please click "Keep it" (or "Yes, stop it"). Keep it cancels. Yes, stop it ends the reminders. Past records are kept, so history still makes sense. After that, Keep it: the question closes. Yes, stop it: back to Kamala's page, without that medicine.
c50: Step 50. Next, kindly click "Sign out" when finished. This signs this phone out. Do this on a shared or borrowed phone. After that, back to the Sign in screen. Kamala's phone stays connected.
end: And that's every click. Thank you for staying with me all the way. The everyday routine is really just three taps. For Kamala: when the alarm rings, take the pill, and gently tap Taken. For Priya: open her name to see today. The alerts come all by themselves. And the setup is needed only once. Thank you so much for your time, and your kind attention. We truly hope GoldenDose brings comfort and peace of mind to you, and to the people you care about. Take care.
